flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: Your membership renews automatically for successive 12-month terms at the then-current rate unless you cancel in writing at least 3 days before the renewal date; it does not end on its own.

flags.sourceSentence: To stop a renewal you must deliver written notice of cancellation to the Member Services desk no later than three (3) days before the renewal date.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day cancellation window commits you to a full additional 12-month term of dues at the then-current rate, and a suspended, frozen or medical-hold membership keeps renewing on the same schedule.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the dues, fees, hours and any term of the agreement at any time, and the changes apply to you from the posting date, so a fee or dues increase could take effect mid-term without your signature.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: You could owe Meridian money and legal fees for third-party claims arising from your own use of the gym, your conduct, your guests' conduct, or any service you provide to another member, and Meridian picks the lawyer and must consent to any settlement.

flags.sourceSentence: You may end your Program enrolment by notifying the Program ofﬁce in writing at least ninety (90) days before the anniversary date, in which case no further tuition is charged and your candidacy closes at the end of the Program year then running.
flags.consequence: Your Program tuition renews automatically each year at the then-current rate unless you give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date; missing the window commits you to another year of tuition.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after your Program candidacy ends, you cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training — as employee, contractor or on your own account — within 15 miles of any Meridian location where you taught or trained, and you cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: You give up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join a class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose award is final.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Meridian can raise your dues once every 12 months by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, and you are billed automatically from your payment method until the agreement ends and your balance is nil.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: The late charge, returned-payment charge, keycard replacement charge and account reinstatement charge are set in a separate Schedule of Fees that Meridian can change by posting, so the amounts you owe for these events are not fixed in the agreement and could increase without your signature.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at 12 months of dues and fees, and it is not liable for lost income, lost business opportunity, or loss of or damage to your property, including property left in a locker.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: You are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or account, so if someone else uses your keycard or account and causes a loss or breach of the rules, you could face charges or consequences for their entry.

flags.sourceSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.consequence: A candidate who falls short of the expected 60 supervised teaching hours in a Program year may be held back a year at Meridian's discretion, potentially extending the time (and any associated costs) before certification.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the signer ends the licence early, they lose the entire $45 fee, even if they leave with most of the season remaining.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any of the signer's belongings still on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames, tools — becomes the Association's property to keep or dispose of, with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: Missing the 30-day pre-anniversary cancellation deadline commits the signer to a further twelve months of annual fees at whatever rate is then in effect, which could be higher than the original.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: If the service fails — including losing the signer's work or a failed export — the signer can recover at most the fees paid for the single Billing Period in which the problem occurred, which may be far less than the value of lost work or revenue.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay the provider's legal costs and any third-party claim arising from content they uploaded, exported or published — an open-ended obligation not limited to what they paid for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against the provider; disputes go to individual binding arbitration, with the award final and no appeal.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: The provider can raise the subscription price at any time, and the signer either pays the new fee from the next Billing Period or loses access to a tool their work may depend on.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: Unpaid amounts accrue interest at 1.5% per month (about 18% a year) and a suspended account can only be reactivated by paying a charge set unilaterally in the provider's Fee Schedule, which can be changed at any time.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically every Billing Period without a fresh signature, and a cancellation made even one day into a new period still bills the signer for that entire period with no refund.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: The provider can change the contract, pricing and fee schedule at any time, and simply continuing to use the service counts as agreeing to the new version — including changes that increase the signer's costs or obligations.

flags.sourceSentence: We may suspend or close an account that has not paid, that has breached Section 1, or that is being used to store content we are required by law to remove.
flags.consequence: If the provider closes the account for alleged breach of Section 1 (for example, its belief that credentials were shared), the signer loses access with no refund of the Billing Period already paid.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends, the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the Restricted Field defined in Exhibit B, as an employee, consultant, contractor, adviser or principal, and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with. Since the role is at will, Ardent could end the employment and the signer would still be barred from their field for a year.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses and attorney fees arising from an alleged breach of the confidentiality or non-compete sections, or from a former employer's claim that the new job violates an obligation owed to that former employer — a cost that is open-ended.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to take any employment-related claim — including statutory claims — to a court or jury, and cannot join a class, collective or representative action; all claims must go to individual, final and binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: The signer must repay the entire $15,000 signing payment within 30 days of their last working day if they resign or are terminated for cause within the first 12 months.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can change, withdraw or reinterpret any policy, benefit or term described in the offer — including compensation-related plan terms — at any time without the signer's agreement, with the intranet version governing from publication.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself automatically every month without any notice or fresh signature, so it will not end on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it, and rent already paid for the move-out month is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The operator's liability for loss of or damage to stored property, including damage the operator's own negligence causes, is capped at $5,000, so any loss above that amount falls on the occupant unless they declared a higher value and paid a fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must cover the operator's legal costs and damages for any third-party claim connected to the unit, the stored property, or anyone the occupant lets onto the premises, with no cap stated.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If rent or any charge goes unpaid, the operator can deny access to the unit, overlock it, and after the legally required notice period sell all the stored contents and keep the proceeds to cover what is owed.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice, and the occupant must either pay the higher amount or end the agreement on the operator's timeline.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late rent and each notice about an unpaid balance trigger charges whose amounts are not in the agreement itself but in a separate schedule the operator controls and can post or publish, so the occupant cannot know the full cost of falling behind from this document alone.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant is required to keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and to produce evidence of it on request.
flags.consequence: The occupant must maintain insurance on the stored property for its full value and show evidence of it whenever the operator asks; without it, the occupant bears all risk of loss themselves.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The operator can change the rules, gate hours, and the terms of the agreement itself by posting a notice and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes binding from the first day of the following month; the occupant bears the burden of keeping contact details current.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan automatically renews for another twelve months at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate, unless the signer tells Cascade to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term — missing that deadline commits them to a full year at a higher, unstated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional plan before its term ends triggers the entire unpaid device instalment balance becoming due in full on the next bill, which could be a large lump-sum charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at one bill period's service charges on the affected line, and it excludes lost profits, lost data, and indirect or consequential losses, so the signer could bear substantial uncompensated losses from service or device failures.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Cascade's claims, losses, expenses and reasonable legal fees arising from use of the service, anything sent from or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, and any charge incurred on the account — an open-ended obligation with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, and must resolve any dispute through individual binding arbitration — removing the court route for contesting serious problems.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The signer can introduce or increase a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge on one bill's notice, and these are not government-required taxes, so the signer's monthly cost could rise without a fresh agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance accrues a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance each bill period until paid, and a suspended-then-restored line incurs a restoral charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term, charge, or rate plan feature on notice (which may be given on a bill, by device message, or by email), and continued use of the service after the effective date counts as accepting the change — the signer could face higher or new charges without signing anything.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a monthly plan has no fixed term and continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled.
flags.consequence: On a monthly plan, service continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled — it does not end on its own, so the signer must actively cancel to stop charges.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a line does not prorate the final bill period, so the signer pays for the full period even if they cancel early in it.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme at any point for any reason, leaving the Analyst with as little as one week of stipend and cutting short the housing advance repayment period.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can unilaterally change the Handbook, assessments, teaching schedule and even the terms of this Agreement itself, effective immediately by email, so the deal the Analyst signed may not be the deal in force a week later.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any paid or unpaid role — employee, contractor or intern — with any firm on the Restricted List, and cannot approach clients whose files they worked on, which could block a wide range of future work with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm's claims, losses, expenses and legal costs arising from a breach of the confidentiality or post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients — an open-ended amount with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, so any dispute — including over the indemnity or the post-programme restrictions — must be fought alone in individual binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: Any housing advance instalment not repaid within ten days of its due date accrues a late charge, set in the Handbook the Firm can change at any time, until the advance is repaid in full.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must keep every client name, model, memorandum and data set confidential forever, with no time limit, and breach could trigger the Section 6 indemnity.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the Handbook's replacement cost for any issued laptop, security token or building pass not returned within five working days of the last day of the Programme.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee. After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: The signer can lose part or all of the $120 fee if they give up the place: only half the fee comes back if they cancel after the seven-day mark but before the third lesson, and nothing comes back after the third lesson.
